sections.title: Summary
sections.content: Software engineer and architect with expertise in building scalable applications. Passionate about clean code, system design, and delivering impactful solutions. Looking to contribute in a technology leadership role where I can deepen my technical expertise, coach my team, and drive measurable product outcomes.

highlights.text: Used AI to create a project for parsing CAS. 1 month effort was reduced to 2 days
Implemented TDD for new projects which resulted in cleaner code and > 80% line coverage throughout
Built a new Wealth Management Platform handling AUM > 14K crores for the company. Migrated all data for smooth transition for clients, RMs and Operations team
Cross team collaboration to understand the current process and implementing the tech to reduce manual efforts by Operations Team
Integrated various Fintech vendors to enhance and automate the existing process
Developed OKR system with varuous integrations - sheets, zoho etc to automate Key result and objective tracking
Created a notification system to blast hundreds of thousands of notification while respecting the rate limit set by Facebook's Workplace
Created Workplace(By Facebook) integrations for various bots
